en: Black‑and‑white view of a broad cobbled town square with an equestrian statue at its center. On both sides stand rows of 3–4 story buildings with shops, cafés, and traditional German signage. To the left is a building labeled "Cafe Central" and another sign for "Adolf Meyer". On the right are facades with painted signs including "Carl Lochmann". In the background rise two tall, identical neo‑Gothic church towers. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll across the square.
